skills.name: knowledge-ops
skills.summary: Use when a Head of Ops, Knowledge Manager, or TPM-Internal needs to author, validate, or clean up company SOPs and internal runbooks (procurement intake, vendor offboarding, incident-comms cascade, employee onboarding) — including 5W2H completeness checks (Who-What-When-Where-Why-How-HowMuch), cross-link and orphan-page validation across a sprawling Notion/Confluence/Obsidian wiki, KB ingestion + hygiene reporting, and runbook step verification (named owner, expected duration, observable success signal, rollback path, escalation contact). Pairs Ishikawa's 5W2H method, Gawande's *The Checklist Manifesto*, ISO 9001, ITIL v4, and Google SRE Workbook runbook discipline with deterministic stdlib-only Python tools that score completeness, detect anti-patterns, and emit prioritized cleanup lists (e.g., "validate this runbook before it goes into rotation", "audit our Confluence wiki for stale and orphaned SOPs").

en.purpose: Generates 5W2H SOP scaffolds, validates runbook steps, and audits Markdown knowledge bases for stale, orphaned, ownerless, or terminology-drifted documents.
scenarios: Author an employee-onboarding SOP.
Validate a runbook before rotation.
Prioritize cleanup of a Notion, Confluence, or Obsidian Markdown export.
en.io: Input: SOP metadata JSON, a Markdown or JSON runbook, or a directory of Markdown files. Output: SOP scaffold, per-step validation report, knowledge-base link map, hygiene findings, and prioritized cleanup list.
dependencies: Owner and review metadata for complete analysis
en.boundary: Structural validation cannot establish that runbook content is operationally correct. PDF- or HTML-only sources require prior conversion. Orphan detection is a prioritization signal, not an instruction to delete, and regulatory profiles do not substitute for a formal compliance review.

zh.purpose: 生成 5W2H SOP 框架、校验运行手册步骤，并审计 Markdown 知识库中的过期、孤立、无负责人和术语漂移问题。
scenarios: 编写员工入职 SOP。
在轮值前校验运行手册。
为 Notion、Confluence 或 Obsidian 的 Markdown 导出确定清理优先级。
zh.io: 输入：SOP 元数据 JSON、Markdown/JSON 运行手册或 Markdown 目录。输出：SOP 框架、逐步骤校验报告、知识库链接图、卫生问题和优先清理列表。
dependencies: 可导出为 Markdown 的知识库
用于完整分析的负责人和复查元数据
zh.boundary: 结构校验不能证明运行手册内容在业务上正确；仅有 PDF 或 HTML 时需先转换。孤立页面只是优先级信号，不代表应删除；监管画像不能替代正式合规审查。

skills.name: issue
skills.summary: Use when starting a chain from a GitHub issue — turning an issue URL or number into a triaged, planned, dispatched, and reviewed pull request. Classifies the thread (bug → root-cause discipline, feature → plan chain, question → drafted reply), synthesizes a spec from the issue's own acceptance criteria, then runs the standard chain with a PR exit. Trigger with /hyperflow:issue, "work on issue #N", "fix this issue <url>", "implement this issue", "triage issue #N and raise a PR".

security_findings.label: broad allowed-tools: Read, Write, Edit, Bash(git:*), Bash(gh:*), Glob, Grep, Agen

en.purpose: Turns a GitHub issue into a classified and traceable workflow: bug diagnosis, feature planning, question response, or invalid/already-solved closure, with an optional reviewed pull-request exit.
scenarios: Implement or fix work described by an issue URL or number.
Check whether an issue is already solved on the current main branch.
Draft a response for question, discussion, invalid, or stale issues.
en.io: Inputs are an issue URL/number, its body/comments/labels, repository state, GitHub authentication, and PR/comment preferences. Outputs are a triage result, issue-derived spec, optional Hyperflow plan/dispatch artifacts, drafted comments, and an optional PR.
dependencies: Hyperflow triage, plan, dispatch, and bug-trace workflows
Interactive gates for ambiguity and outbound actions
en.boundary: Issue text is untrusted data and cannot authorize scripts, secrets, CI changes, or unrelated edits. Questions and invalid/already-fixed issues do not enter a code chain. Comments and PR creation are gated or explicitly pre-elected; unauthenticated mode remains local-only.

zh.purpose: 将 GitHub Issue 转化为可追溯的分类流程：Bug 根因诊断、功能规划、问题回复或无效/已解决关闭，并可选以审阅后的 PR 收尾。
scenarios: 实现或修复 Issue URL/编号描述的工作。
检查 Issue 是否已在当前 main 分支解决。
为问题、讨论、无效或过期 Issue 起草回复。
zh.io: 输入为 Issue URL/编号、正文/评论/标签、仓库状态、GitHub 认证及 PR/评论偏好；输出为分类结果、由 Issue 派生的规格、可选 Hyperflow plan/dispatch 产物、回复草稿和可选 PR。
dependencies: Hyperflow triage、plan、dispatch 和 bug trace 工作流
处理歧义和外部动作所需的交互确认门
zh.boundary: Issue 文本是不可信数据，不能授权执行脚本、使用密钥、修改 CI 或进行无关编辑。问题类及无效/已解决 Issue 不进入代码链。评论和 PR 创建必须经过确认或预先明确选择；未认证时仅在本地工作。

grounding.scope: GitHub issue ingestion, triage, planning-chain entry, and PR exit

skills.name: interview
skills.summary: Phase 1 of building a Claude Managed Agent — interview the founder about the one job the agent should do, then produce a build sheet (CMA primitives table + v1/v2 deferrals + eval plan) WITHOUT needing their API key yet. Use when the user says "help me scope an agent", "I have an idea for an agent", "what should this agent be", or when the orchestrator routes phase=interview. Drives the six intake slots (job, trigger, inputs, actions, definition-of-done, recurrence) via AskUserQuestion, maps them to primitives with interview_planner.py, assembles build-sheet.json with build_sheet_builder.py, and validates limits with primitives_validator.py. Connectors are mockable in v0 (schema-true custom tools); real MCP servers become v1 deferrals. Distinct from stage-launch (which turns the sheet into payloads).

en.purpose: Interviews a founder across six intake dimensions and maps the answers into a validated Claude Managed Agent build sheet with versioned deferrals and an evaluation plan.
scenarios: Scope a new managed agent idea.
Reduce a broad concept to one end-to-end job.
Plan mocked integrations before a later real MCP connection.
en.io: Input: job, trigger, inputs, actions, definition of done, and recurrence. Output: plan.json, build-sheet.json, primitive validation results, v1/v2 deferrals, and next-phase goal state.
dependencies: Claude Managed Agent primitive definitions referenced by the skill
en.boundary: This phase produces a plan only and explicitly does not require or use an API key. It does not launch an agent. It limits v0 to one core job and defers real integrations or irreversible actions.

zh.purpose: 围绕六个维度访谈创始人，并把答案映射成经过校验的 Claude Managed Agent 构建表、版本化延期项和评测计划。
scenarios: 梳理新的托管代理想法。
把宽泛概念收敛为一个端到端任务。
先规划模拟集成，再在后续版本连接真实 MCP。
zh.io: 输入：任务、触发器、输入、动作、完成标准和重复方式。输出：plan.json、build-sheet.json、原语校验结果、v1/v2 延期项和下一阶段目标状态。
dependencies: 技能引用的 Claude Managed Agent 原语定义
zh.boundary: 本阶段只产出计划，明确不需要也不使用 API 密钥，不会启动代理。v0 只保留一个核心任务，真实集成和不可逆动作会延期。

skills.name: internal-comms
skills.summary: Use when a Head of People Ops, BizOps lead, or Internal Communications owner needs to draft and sequence an internal-only change-management communication — a re-org announcement, a tool rollout, a policy change, a leadership transition, a layoff, an acquisition close, or an internal product launch — and the audience is employees (not customers). Pairs Prosci ADKAR and Kotter's 8-step change model with deterministic stdlib-only Python tools to produce a sequenced touchpoint calendar, a Kotter-compliant primary announcement, an audience-segmented FAQ, and manager cascade talking points; industry-tuned via --profile {tech-startup, scaleup, enterprise, public-company, non-profit}. Triggers on "all-hands announcement", "change comms", "rollout comms", "re-org announcement", "manager talking points", "layoff comms".

en.purpose: Creates an employee-facing change-communication package comprising a primary announcement, segmented FAQ, manager talking points, and sequenced touchpoint calendar.
scenarios: Prepare a reorganization announcement.
Plan communications for a tool or policy rollout.
Draft a layoff or leadership-transition communication package.
en.io: Input: change type, audience segments, magnitude, effective date, available channels, and industry profile. Output: structured announcement, seven-touchpoint calendar, pre-communication, FAQ, follow-up, and manager cascade material.
dependencies: Named sponsor and audience information for publication-ready drafts
en.boundary: Employee-facing only; it does not decide whether the change should occur or author the underlying legal policy. Outputs remain drafts without sponsor authority. High-impact events may require legal, HR, and jurisdiction-specific review outside this skill.

zh.purpose: 生成面向员工的变更沟通包，包括主公告、分群 FAQ、经理话术和按顺序安排的触达日历。
scenarios: 准备组织重组公告。
规划工具或政策上线沟通。
起草裁员或领导层变更沟通包。
zh.io: 输入：变更类型、受众分群、影响等级、生效日期、可用渠道和行业画像。输出：结构化公告、七次触达日历、预沟通、FAQ、后续沟通和经理级联材料。
dependencies: 用于形成可发布草案的明确赞助人和受众信息
zh.boundary: 只面向内部员工；不决定是否应实施变更，也不撰写底层法律政策。没有赞助人授权时仅为草案；高影响事件仍可能需要法律、HR 和属地审查。

skills.name: hyperflow-trace
skills.summary: Hyperflow debugging. Use for bugs, test failures, runtime errors, broken builds, or "this doesn't work" reports — verbs like debug, "fix it", solve, "why is X failing", "Y is broken", or a pasted stack trace. Systematic root-cause analysis before any patch — never blind-patch symptoms.

en.purpose: Provides an Antigravity-oriented single-agent sequence for reproducing a failure, applying 5 Whys, testing hypotheses, making a minimal root-cause fix, and verifying it.
scenarios: Debug a failing test.
Investigate a broken build.
Fix a runtime failure with a regression test.
en.io: Input: error, stack trace, failing test, or bug description. Output: confirmed root-cause evidence, minimal patch, regression test, verification results, self-review, and a conventional commit.
dependencies: Git for the documented commit step
en.boundary: Does not provide multi-agent verification. It should stop rather than ship a speculative fix when hypotheses cannot establish a root cause. The evidence describes code changes and commits but does not demonstrate their execution.

zh.purpose: 为 Antigravity 单代理环境提供调试流程：复现失败、执行 5 Whys、验证假设、最小化根因修复并复核。
scenarios: 调试失败测试。
调查构建失败。
通过回归测试修复运行时故障。
zh.io: 输入：错误、堆栈、失败测试或缺陷描述。输出：根因证据、最小补丁、回归测试、验证结果、自审和约定式提交。
dependencies: 用于文档所述提交步骤的 Git
zh.boundary: 不提供多代理独立验证。若假设无法确认根因，应停止而不是提交猜测性修复。证据只描述改动与提交步骤，不证明它们已经执行。

skills.name: hyperflow-sticky
skills.summary: Hyperflow auto-routing mode. Use to control how aggressively hyperflow auto-routes — "make hyperflow sticky", "stop using hyperflow", "auto-route to hyperflow", "disable hyperflow auto-routing". Sets on (every task-shaped message routes) / auto (intent-verb messages route — default) / off (no auto-routing).

en.purpose: Sets Hyperflow routing aggressiveness to on, auto, or off for an Antigravity project.
scenarios: Route every task-shaped request.
Use intent-verb routing only.
Disable automatic routing.
en.io: Input: on, auto, or off. Output: the selected word written to .hyperflow/.sticky-mode and a status confirmation.
en.boundary: Only stores routing preference and does not execute work. The file name and format are specific to this Antigravity template and differ from the full Hyperflow sticky skill.

zh.purpose: 在 Antigravity 项目中把 Hyperflow 路由强度设置为 on、auto 或 off。
scenarios: 路由所有任务型请求。
只使用意图动词路由。
关闭自动路由。
zh.io: 输入：on、auto 或 off。输出：把所选单词写入 .hyperflow/.sticky-mode，并返回状态确认。
dependencies: 能够读取 .sticky-mode 的核心 Hyperflow 技能
zh.boundary: 只保存路由偏好，不执行任务。文件名和格式属于该 Antigravity 模板，与完整 Hyperflow sticky 技能不同。

skills.name: hyperflow-status
skills.summary: Hyperflow project status. Use to see current hyperflow state — "what is hyperflow doing", "show task progress", "where are we". Read-only — reports in-flight tasks, memory count, and progress. Never modifies state or runs work.

en.purpose: Reads Hyperflow artifacts and prints a compact project-status block for an Antigravity single-agent setup.
scenarios: Inspect active task progress.
Count existing specs and audits.
Check project memory size.
en.io: Input: .hyperflow task, spec, audit, and memory files. Output: one status block with active tasks, progress, branch fields when present, artifact counts, and memory count.
en.boundary: Read-only; it never edits files or runs work. If .hyperflow is absent, it only reports that condition and suggests scaffolding.

zh.purpose: 读取 Hyperflow 产物，并为 Antigravity 单代理环境输出紧凑的项目状态块。
scenarios: 查看活动任务进度。
统计规格和审计文件。
检查项目记忆数量。
zh.io: 输入：.hyperflow 中的任务、规格、审计和记忆文件。输出：单个状态块，包含活动任务、进度、可用时的分支字段、产物计数和记忆计数。
dependencies: 可读的 .hyperflow 目录和 Markdown 产物
zh.boundary: 完全只读，不编辑文件也不执行工作。.hyperflow 缺失时只报告该情况并建议初始化。

skills.name: hyperflow-scaffold
skills.summary: Hyperflow project setup. Use when starting hyperflow in a new project or refreshing its cache — "init hyperflow", "set up hyperflow", "refresh hyperflow", "scaffold hyperflow". One-shot setup of the .hyperflow/ project cache + memory and the .agent/workflows/hyperflow* slash commands. Does not start the plan → dispatch chain.

en.purpose: Initializes missing Hyperflow cache, memory, context, runtime directories, and Antigravity slash-command workflow files without starting execution.
scenarios: Initialize Hyperflow in a new repository.
Refresh missing Hyperflow project surfaces.
Install project-local Antigravity workflow commands.
en.io: Input: an existing project repository and shipped Antigravity workflow templates. Output: missing .hyperflow directories and stubs, factual context files, copied .agent/workflows commands, and a one-line summary.
dependencies: Readable repository structure for context generation
en.boundary: Intended to be idempotent and not overwrite existing Hyperflow content. It does not start planning or implementation, and generated context is limited to facts discoverable from the repository.

zh.purpose: 初始化缺失的 Hyperflow 缓存、记忆、上下文、运行目录和 Antigravity 斜杠命令文件，但不启动执行链。
scenarios: 在新仓库中初始化 Hyperflow。
补齐缺失的 Hyperflow 项目表面。
安装项目级 Antigravity 工作流命令。
zh.io: 输入：现有项目仓库和随附的 Antigravity 工作流模板。输出：缺失的 .hyperflow 目录与存根、事实性上下文文件、复制的 .agent/workflows 命令和单行摘要。
zh.boundary: 设计为幂等且不覆盖现有 Hyperflow 内容；不会启动规划或实现。生成的上下文仅限仓库中可观察到的事实。

skills.name: hyperflow-plan
skills.summary: Hyperflow planning phase. Use when a request needs shaping before code — a rough prompt to sharpen, an ambiguous idea to design, or a clear-enough task to decompose. Verbs like plan, design, brainstorm, explore, "should we", "what's the best way to", scope, decompose, "plan out", "break down", "enhance this prompt". Thinking, not building. Writes an optional spec to .hyperflow/specs/<slug>.md and a task file to .hyperflow/tasks/<slug>.md, then hands off to hyperflow-dispatch.

en.purpose: Researches and shapes a request, optionally creates a design specification, and decomposes the work into ordered batches and commit-sized subtasks.
scenarios: Turn an ambiguous idea into a design and plan.
Decompose a clear multi-file change.
Prepare a task file for later execution.
en.io: Input: user request, repository context, AGENTS.md, and Hyperflow memory. Output: optional .hyperflow/specs/<slug>.md, required .hyperflow/tasks/<slug>.md, verification plan, and dispatch handoff.
dependencies: Hyperflow dispatch skill for automatic handoff
en.boundary: Planning only: it forbids source-code edits. Design-path questions and approvals may pause execution. The resulting plan reflects repository evidence available at planning time and does not establish implementation feasibility until executed.

zh.purpose: 调研并整理请求，可选生成设计规格，再把工作拆成有序批次和提交粒度子任务。
scenarios: 把模糊想法转成设计与计划。
拆解明确的多文件改动。
为后续执行准备任务文件。
zh.io: 输入：用户请求、仓库上下文、AGENTS.md 和 Hyperflow 记忆。输出：可选的 .hyperflow/specs/<slug>.md、必需的 .hyperflow/tasks/<slug>.md、验证计划和执行交接。
dependencies: 可读的仓库和项目指令
用于自动交接的 Hyperflow dispatch 技能
zh.boundary: 只做规划，禁止修改源代码。设计路径中的问题和审批可能暂停流程。计划基于当时可读的仓库证据，实际可行性需执行后才能确认。

skills.name: hyperflow-dispatch
skills.summary: Hyperflow execution phase. Use when a task file exists in .hyperflow/tasks/ and the work needs building — verbs like build, implement, add, refactor, "wire up", "run the plan", "execute the task". Works batches sequentially with self-review and per-task commits. In Antigravity there is no sub-agent fan-out — the single agent does each batch itself.

en.purpose: Executes a Hyperflow task file batch by batch in a single-agent environment, with self-review, project quality gates, per-subtask commits, and task-state updates.
scenarios: Implement an existing Hyperflow plan.
Run sequential batches in Antigravity.
Finish and review a multi-subtask coding task.
en.io: Input: .hyperflow/tasks task file and project source. Output: implemented changes, test and quality-gate results, conventional commits, updated task status, memory entries, and a final audit/deploy choice.
dependencies: Project lint, typecheck, and test commands
en.boundary: Single-agent only; it has no independent worker fan-out. It assumes authorization to edit and commit the repository, never auto-pushes, and stops on a declared security violation or unresolved quality failure.

zh.purpose: 在单代理环境中按批执行 Hyperflow 任务文件，进行自审、项目质量门禁、逐子任务提交和任务状态更新。
scenarios: 实现现有 Hyperflow 计划。
在 Antigravity 中顺序执行多个批次。
完成并复核多子任务编码工作。
zh.io: 输入：.hyperflow/tasks 任务文件和项目源码。输出：实现改动、测试与门禁结果、约定式提交、更新后的任务状态、记忆条目和最终审计/部署选择。
dependencies: 现有 Hyperflow 任务文件
可写的项目及 .hyperflow 文件
项目 lint、类型检查和测试命令
zh.boundary: 仅单代理执行，没有独立工作代理并行。假设已获授权修改和提交仓库，不会自动推送；遇到声明的安全违规或无法解决的质量失败时停止。

skills.name: hyperflow-design
skills.summary: Hyperflow design phase. Use when designing a UI / visual system or making a screen look good — verbs like "design the UI", "make it look good", "design the screen", "visual design", "design system". Establishes or extends a domain-grounded design system, researches real-world prior art, and renders it slop-free. Thinking and taste, not building.

en.purpose: Establishes or extends a project design system and records a researched visual direction and signature treatment before implementation.
scenarios: Design a product screen.
Create or extend a design system.
Define a visual direction with motion or mobile considerations.
en.io: Input: design brief, project domain, existing design system, and at least two real-world references. Output: updated .hyperflow/design/system.md and a design specification containing bound tokens, signature, references, and accessibility constraints.
dependencies: Access to relevant local taste skills when available
Current reference sources for design claims
en.boundary: Produces design documents only, not production code. It requires researched references and defers to accessibility constraints. Quality depends on the relevance and availability of the selected references and local taste guidance.

zh.purpose: 在实现前建立或扩展项目设计系统，并记录有现实案例依据的视觉方向和标志性处理。
scenarios: 设计产品页面。
创建或扩展设计系统。
定义包含动效或移动端考虑的视觉方向。
zh.io: 输入：设计简报、项目领域、现有设计系统及至少两个真实案例。输出：更新后的 .hyperflow/design/system.md 和包含绑定 token、标志性设计、参考资料及无障碍约束的规格。
dependencies: 可写的 .hyperflow 设计与规格文件
可用时的本地 taste 技能
用于设计主张的当前参考来源
zh.boundary: 只产出设计文档，不写生产代码。要求有研究依据，并在冲突时服从无障碍约束；质量取决于参考案例和本地设计指导的相关性与可用性。

skills.name: hyperflow-deploy
skills.summary: Hyperflow ship phase. Use when the user is ready to release — verbs like ship, push, release, deploy, "cut a release", "ready to push". Runs pre-push gates (lint + typecheck + build + tests + security sweep), then asks before pushing. Never --no-verify, never force-push to main.

en.purpose: Runs lint, typecheck, build, tests, and a basic diff-oriented secret/blocklist sweep, then asks whether to push the current branch.
scenarios: Prepare a branch for release.
Run pre-push project gates.
Push approved commits after reviewing branch state.
en.io: Input: current repository, branch, diff, and project commands. Output: concise pass/fail gate report, branch ahead/behind state, and either a normal git push or a held local state after user choice.
dependencies: Project lint, typecheck, build, and test commands
en.boundary: Push is always gated by explicit confirmation. It never bypasses hooks or force-pushes main/master. A basic sweep is not a comprehensive security audit, and missing or externally failing project gates can block release.

zh.purpose: 运行 lint、类型检查、构建、测试和基于差异的基础秘密/禁用文件检查，然后询问是否推送当前分支。
scenarios: 为分支发布做准备。
运行推送前项目门禁。
在确认分支状态后推送已批准提交。
zh.io: 输入：当前仓库、分支、差异和项目命令。输出：简洁的门禁通过/失败报告、分支领先/落后状态，以及用户选择后的普通 git push 或保留本地状态。
dependencies: Git 仓库和已配置远端
项目 lint、类型检查、构建和测试命令
zh.boundary: 推送始终需要明确确认；不会绕过钩子，也不会强推 main/master。基础扫描不是全面安全审计，缺失或受外部改动影响的门禁可能阻止发布。

skills.name: hyperflow-cache
skills.summary: Hyperflow memory manager. Use to view, search, add, edit, prune, or clear hyperflow project memory — "show memory", "search memory for X", "clear memory", "what does hyperflow remember about Y". CRUD over .hyperflow/memory/ only — never touches source code.

en.purpose: Lists, searches, adds, edits, prunes, or clears project memories stored in four Hyperflow Markdown files.
scenarios: Search prior project decisions.
Record a durable pitfall or pattern.
Prune stale memory entries.
en.io: Input: operation, optional search term, entry, category, or target. Output: displayed matches or modified .hyperflow/memory decisions, learnings, pitfalls, or patterns files.
dependencies: Readable and, for mutations, writable .hyperflow/memory files
en.boundary: Restricted to .hyperflow/memory and must not touch source code. Destructive clearing requires confirmation. It records non-obvious rationale, not information already represented by repository history.

zh.purpose: 列出、搜索、新增、编辑、修剪或清空存放在四个 Hyperflow Markdown 文件中的项目记忆。
scenarios: 搜索既有项目决策。
记录长期有效的陷阱或模式。
清理过期记忆条目。
zh.io: 输入：操作，以及可选的搜索词、条目、分类或目标。输出：显示匹配项，或修改 .hyperflow/memory 下的 decisions、learnings、pitfalls、patterns 文件。
dependencies: 可读且在变更时可写的 .hyperflow/memory 文件
清空等破坏性操作所需的交互确认
zh.boundary: 范围只限 .hyperflow/memory，不得触碰源代码。清空前必须确认；只记录非显而易见的原因，不重复仓库历史已表达的信息。

skills.name: hyperflow-audit
skills.summary: Hyperflow code review. Use when the user wants the current diff, a commit, branch, or PR reviewed — verbs like audit, review, "check for issues", "security check", "code review". Multi-level review (L1 quick → L5 exhaustive), writes findings to .hyperflow/audits/, then a fix-gate.

en.purpose: Reviews a diff, commit, branch, or PR at a selected depth and persists structured findings in a Hyperflow audit file.
scenarios: Review the current diff for correctness.
Run an elevated review for auth or external-input changes.
Prepare findings for a subsequent fix plan.
en.io: Input: review target and optional level 1–5. Output: findings labeled by severity with file and line, concrete remediation, security table at level 3+, audit Markdown file, and optional fix-routing choice.
dependencies: Readable Git diff and affected files
Interactive choice capability when significant findings exist
en.boundary: Single-agent review without independent reviewer separation. Default depth is limited, and security checks become mandatory only at level 3+. It reports evidence from the selected scope and does not establish absence of defects outside that scope.

zh.purpose: 按选定深度审查差异、提交、分支或 PR，并把结构化发现写入 Hyperflow 审计文件。
scenarios: 审查当前差异的正确性。
对认证或外部输入改动执行更高等级审查。
为后续修复计划准备问题清单。
zh.io: 输入：审查目标和可选的 1–5 级。输出：带严重度、文件、行号和修复建议的问题；3 级以上含安全表；写入审计 Markdown，并可选择进入修复流程。
dependencies: 可读的 Git 差异和受影响文件
存在重要问题时的交互选择能力
zh.boundary: 属于单代理审查，没有独立复核者。默认深度有限，安全检查仅从 3 级起强制；结论只覆盖所选范围，不能证明范围外不存在缺陷。

skills.name: hyperflow
skills.summary: Use when applying Hyperflow's orchestration doctrine in Codex, Antigravity, Grok, or another single-agent surface. Auto-invoke for non-trivial engineering work: build, implement, add, refactor, debug, fix, review, audit, plan, scope, design, brainstorm, ship, or deploy. Trigger with /hyperflow:hyperflow, "use hyperflow", "apply the doctrine", or automatically on any task-shaped message.

security_findings.label: broad allowed-tools: Read, Write, Edit, Glob, Grep, Agent, Skill, AskUserQuestion

en.purpose: Adapts Hyperflow's planning, execution, review, debugging, and deployment doctrine to Codex and other agent hosts, using native subagents when available and inline worker/reviewer phases otherwise.
scenarios: Route plan, dispatch, workflow, trace, audit, deploy, or scaffold requests on non-Claude hosts.
Apply structured decomposition and review to non-trivial engineering work.
Continue Hyperflow chains when native Skill or structured-question tools are unavailable.
en.io: Input is a task-shaped engineering request or a Hyperflow function alias plus project rules and runtime capabilities. Output is the corresponding workflow's artifacts, implementation/review results, interaction gates, commits, or deployment actions as selected.
dependencies: A host capable of loading skills
Project AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md and Hyperflow doctrine files
Git/GitHub/package tooling when required by the routed workflow
en.boundary: This is an orchestration layer, not a substitute for each routed workflow's detailed instructions. Required gates must not be skipped when structured UI is absent; they are rendered in chat instead. It must respect project rules, security blocks, no-attribution constraints, and outbound-action approvals.

zh.purpose: 将 Hyperflow 的规划、执行、审查、调试和部署准则适配到 Codex 等代理宿主；有原生子代理时使用子代理，否则以内联工作者/审阅者阶段执行。
scenarios: 在非 Claude 宿主上路由 plan、dispatch、workflow、trace、audit、deploy 或 scaffold 请求。
对非简单工程任务应用结构化拆解和审阅。
在缺少原生 Skill 或结构化提问工具时继续 Hyperflow 链。
zh.io: 输入为任务型工程请求或 Hyperflow 功能别名，以及项目规则和运行时能力；输出为对应工作流产物、实现/审查结果、交互确认门、提交或用户选择的部署动作。
dependencies: 可加载技能的代理宿主
项目 AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md 和 Hyperflow doctrine 文件
文件系统及任务所需工具
路由流程需要时的 Git、GitHub 或包管理工具
zh.boundary: 这是编排层，不能替代各被路由工作流的详细规则。缺少结构化 UI 时仍必须在聊天中呈现必要确认门，不能跳过。必须遵守项目规则、安全阻断、无 AI 署名约束和对外动作审批。

grounding.scope: Portable Hyperflow orchestration doctrine for agent runtimes

skills.name: hard-call
skills.summary: /em:hard-call — Framework for decisions with no good options. Use when every option is painful and a structured 10/10/10 + regret-minimization pass is needed — e.g. choosing between a layoff and a down round, or killing a beloved product line.

en.purpose: Structures painful executive decisions using reversibility, 10/10/10 horizons, an outsider perspective, stakeholder impact, announcement drafting, and communication planning.
scenarios: Choose between layoffs and a financing alternative.
Decide whether to remove a co-founder.
Consider pivoting or closing a product line.
en.io: Input: decision, options, reversibility, affected stakeholders, available evidence, and constraints. Output: structured option analysis, stakeholder map, regret-oriented time horizons, announcement test, and communication sequence.
dependencies: Accurate business, legal, financial, and stakeholder context
Qualified advisers for legal, employment, financial, or regulatory consequences
en.boundary: A deliberation framework rather than decision authority. It does not verify facts or replace legal, financial, HR, or board processes. Some source assertions are prescriptive heuristics and should not be treated as universal rules.

zh.purpose: 用可逆性、10/10/10 时间视角、外部接任者视角、利益相关者影响、公告草拟和沟通规划来结构化痛苦的高管决策。
scenarios: 在裁员与融资替代方案之间决策。
考虑是否让联合创始人退出。
评估转型或关闭产品线。
zh.io: 输入：决策、选项、可逆性、受影响人群、现有证据和约束。输出：结构化方案分析、利益相关者地图、时间维度的后悔最小化分析、公告测试和沟通顺序。
dependencies: 准确的业务、法律、财务和利益相关者背景
涉及法律、雇佣、财务或监管后果时的合格专业顾问
zh.boundary: 这是辅助思考框架，不替代决策权；不核验事实，也不能替代法律、财务、HR 或董事会流程。来源中的部分表述属于经验性主张，不应视为普遍规则。

skills.name: handoff
skills.summary: Use when managing a two-session handoff — inspecting, picking up, or reviewing a committed handoff package produced by a session=two scope run. The operator interface over the cross-environment handoff lifecycle (plan in one session, build in another, review back in the first). Trigger with /hyperflow:handoff, "list handoffs", "pick up the handoff", "review the handoff build".

security_findings.label: broad allowed-tools: Read, Write, Edit, Bash(git:*), Bash(mv:*), Glob, Grep, AskU

en.purpose: Lists, inspects, picks up, reviews, and archives committed Hyperflow handoff packages shared between a planning session and a build session.
scenarios: List handoffs awaiting build or review.
Pick up a planned package in another environment.
Audit a completed build and archive the lifecycle.
en.io: Input: list/status/pickup/review/complete command and optional slug. Output: handoff status, dispatched build or audit flow, completion review, updated STATUS, archived package, and conventional archive commit.
dependencies: Hyperflow dispatch, audit, scaffold, and deploy skills
en.boundary: Operates only on the documented package lifecycle and must not amend the build session's commits during review. Review requires STATUS=built and a valid diff range. Push behavior remains subject to configuration and user confirmation.

zh.purpose: 管理规划会话与构建会话之间的已提交 Hyperflow 交接包，包括列出、查看、接手、审查和归档。
scenarios: 列出等待构建或审查的交接。
在另一环境接手 planned 包。
审计已完成构建并归档生命周期。
zh.io: 输入：list/status/pickup/review/complete 命令及可选 slug。输出：交接状态、触发的构建或审计流程、完成复核、更新后的 STATUS、归档包和约定式归档提交。
dependencies: 跨会话共享的 Git 仓库
部署交接时的交互确认
zh.boundary: 仅操作规定的包生命周期；审查时不得修改构建会话的提交。review 要求 STATUS=built 且差异范围有效；推送仍受配置和用户确认约束。

skills.name: grade-iterate
skills.summary: Phase 3 of building a Claude Managed Agent — the bounded grade→iterate loop. Define a CMA outcome (a required markdown rubric graded by an isolated grader), read each verdict, decide the next move (sharpen / re-run / promote to schedule), and once a version passes, run held-back eval cases in parallel. Use when the user says "grade my agent", "make it pass the rubric", "iterate until it's good", "is it good enough", or when the orchestrator routes phase=grade-iterate. outcome_builder.py builds the user.define_outcome payload (rubric required, max_iterations clamped 1..20 — never unbounded); verdict_reader.py reads the grader result and recommends the next move; eval_scaffold.py generates held-back cases + a parallel run plan (capped at the 25-thread CMA ceiling). Distinct from stage-launch (first launch) and run-without-you (scheduling).

en.purpose: Defines a rubric-based Claude Managed Agent outcome, interprets isolated-grader verdicts, iterates within a fixed cap, and prepares held-back evaluations.
scenarios: Grade an agent against explicit criteria.
Iterate a prompt or tool setup until the rubric passes or the cap is reached.
Evaluate a passing version on unseen cases.
en.io: Input: build sheet, 3–5 rubric lines, maximum iterations, grader results, and held-back cases. Output: outcome payload, next-move interpretation, bounded iteration record, held-back eval plan, and ship/escalate decision input.
dependencies: User execution of BYOK API requests outside the tools
en.boundary: Iterations are always capped from 1 to 20, and held-back cases must remain unseen during tuning. The scripts prepare and interpret payloads but do not make API calls or establish generalization beyond the supplied evaluation set.

zh.purpose: 定义基于 rubric 的 Claude Managed Agent 结果，解释隔离评分器的结论，在固定上限内迭代，并准备留出评测。
scenarios: 按明确标准给代理评分。
在达到标准或耗尽上限前调整提示词或工具。
在未见案例上评估已通过版本。
zh.io: 输入：构建表、3–5 条 rubric、最大迭代次数、评分结果和留出案例。输出：outcome 载荷、下一步解释、有界迭代记录、留出评测计划及上线/升级处理的决策输入。
dependencies: Claude Managed Agent 的 outcome/评分器能力
用户在工具外执行 BYOK API 请求
zh.boundary: 迭代始终限制在 1–20 次，留出案例在调优期间必须不可见。脚本只准备和解释载荷，不调用 API，也不能证明超出所给评测集的泛化能力。

skills.name: general-counsel-advisor
skills.summary: General Counsel advisory for startups: contract review (MSA, SaaS, NDA, DPA, employment), IP strategy, term sheet decoding, and regulatory landscape mapping. Use when reviewing any contract or term sheet, deciding when to engage outside counsel, defining IP strategy, evaluating regulatory exposure (HIPAA, GDPR, FDA, fintech), or when user mentions general counsel, GC, legal review, contract risk, term sheet, IP assignment, or regulatory exposure. NOT a substitute for licensed counsel — surfaces questions to bring to qualified attorneys.

en.purpose: Surfaces contract, term-sheet, intellectual-property, and regulatory questions for startups and prepares issues for qualified counsel.
scenarios: Screen an MSA, NDA, DPA, employment agreement, or SaaS contract.
Decode term-sheet economics and control clauses.
Map legal triggers for healthcare, fintech, privacy, AI, or export use cases.
en.io: Input: contract text, term-sheet JSON, planned product features, or IP inventory. Output: clause flags, counterproposal topics, founder-economics analysis, IP checklist, regulatory trigger map, and questions for outside counsel.
dependencies: Python for bundled contract_risk_scanner.py and term_sheet_analyzer.py
Complete source documents and jurisdiction context
Qualified licensed counsel for binding decisions
Optional adjacent finance, security, data, and regulatory expertise
en.boundary: Explicitly not legal advice and not a substitute for licensed counsel. Automated clause matching can miss context, and regulatory or enforceability statements may vary by jurisdiction and change over time.

zh.purpose: 为初创公司识别合同、投资条款、知识产权和监管问题，并整理应提交合格律师的问题。
scenarios: 初筛 MSA、NDA、DPA、劳动合同或 SaaS 协议。
解析投资条款中的经济和控制安排。
映射医疗、金融、隐私、AI 或出口业务的法律触发点。
zh.io: 输入：合同文本、条款清单 JSON、计划中的产品功能或 IP 清单。输出：条款标记、反提案主题、创始人经济影响、IP 清单、监管触发图和外部律师问题。
dependencies: 运行 contract_risk_scanner.py 和 term_sheet_analyzer.py 的 Python
完整原始文件及属地背景
作出约束性决定所需的持牌律师
可选的财务、安全、数据和监管专业支持
zh.boundary: 明确不构成法律意见，也不能替代持牌律师。自动条款匹配可能遗漏上下文，监管与可执行性判断会因司法辖区和时间而变化。

skills.name: flush
skills.summary: Use when the user wants to manually flush a deferred-commit queue from a prior or interrupted chain. Reads .hyperflow/commits-queue/manifest.json, fast-forwards the staging branch onto the user's branch, deletes staging, clears the queue. Recovery interface when a chain crashed before its Step 4 auto-flush ran. Trigger with /hyperflow:flush, "flush pending commits", "flush queue", "apply staged commits", "where are my commits".

security_findings.label: broad allowed-tools: Read, Bash(git:*), Bash(ls:*), Bash(cat:*), Bash(rm:*), Bash

en.purpose: Manually inspects or flushes a persisted Hyperflow deferred-commit queue after an interrupted chain.
scenarios: Preview queued commits with a dry run.
Fast-forward queued staging commits onto the recorded user branch.
Recover when automatic end-of-chain flushing did not run.
en.io: Input: optional --dry-run and .hyperflow/commits-queue/manifest.json. Output: queued-commit listing or a fast-forward result; on divergence, an error and manual recovery suggestions.
dependencies: Claude Code-compatible shell and file-reading tools
en.boundary: Limited to Hyperflow's recorded staging and user branches. It cannot resolve branch divergence automatically; on failure it preserves the staging branch and manifest. Missing staging branches may cause stale queue metadata to be cleared.

zh.purpose: 在 Hyperflow 链路中断后，手动检查或清空持久化的延迟提交队列。
scenarios: 通过 dry-run 预览排队的提交。
将暂存分支中的提交快进合并到清单记录的用户分支。
自动收尾未执行时恢复提交。
zh.io: 输入：可选的 --dry-run 和 .hyperflow/commits-queue/manifest.json。输出：队列提交列表或快进合并结果；分支分叉时输出错误及人工恢复建议。
dependencies: 兼容 Claude Code 的 Shell 与文件读取工具
zh.boundary: 仅处理 Hyperflow 清单记录的暂存分支和用户分支；不能自动解决分叉。失败时保留暂存分支和清单；暂存分支缺失时可能清理失效的队列元数据。

grounding.scope: Hyperflow deferred-commit recovery for a local Git repository.

skills.name: executive-mentor
skills.summary: Adversarial thinking partner for founders and executives. Stress-tests plans, prepares for brutal board meetings, dissects decisions with no good options, and forces honest post-mortems. Use when you need someone to find the holes before the board does, make a decision you've been avoiding, or understand what actually went wrong.

en.purpose: Routes founders and executives to plan challenge, board preparation, hard-decision, assumption stress-test, or postmortem frameworks and supplies an adversarial questioning style.
scenarios: Stress-test a strategic plan.
Prepare for difficult board questions.
Examine a failure or an avoided executive decision.
en.io: Input: plan, agenda, assumption, hard decision, or failed event, plus optional company context. Output: routed framework analysis, vulnerabilities, hard questions, actions, confidence labels, and cross-functional invocation requests where applicable.
en.boundary: Provides challenge and synthesis, not execution authority. Its proactive triggers and cross-role invocation markers require an external orchestrator. Assertions remain dependent on supplied company evidence and should not replace professional legal, financial, or HR review.

zh.purpose: 把创始人和高管请求路由到计划挑战、董事会准备、艰难决策、假设压力测试或复盘框架，并采用对抗式提问。
scenarios: 压力测试战略计划。
准备董事会的尖锐问题。
分析失败事件或长期回避的高管决定。
zh.io: 输入：计划、议程、假设、艰难决定或失败事件，以及可选公司背景。输出：相应框架分析、漏洞、尖锐问题、行动、置信标记和适用时的跨角色请求。
dependencies: 对应命令的 Executive Mentor 子技能
可选的决策矩阵和利益相关者映射脚本
跨角色请求所需的 agent-protocol 约定
zh.boundary: 提供挑战和综合，不拥有执行权。主动触发和跨角色标记需要外部编排器；结论依赖所给公司证据，不能替代法律、财务或 HR 专业审查。

skills.name: dispatch
skills.summary: Use when a task file exists in .hyperflow/tasks/ and workers need dispatching. Fans out parallel workers under per-batch Reviewers, runs a final integration review, and commits per sub-task. Endpoint of the auto-chain — no auto-deploy. Trigger with /hyperflow:dispatch, "run the plan", "execute the task", "build it", "run the batches".

security_findings.label: broad allowed-tools: Read, Write, Edit, Bash(git:*), Bash(gh:*), Bash(grep:*), Ba

en.purpose: Executes Hyperflow task or feature artifacts through parallel workers, staged reviews, quality gates, commits, memory updates, and end-of-build choices.
scenarios: Run batches from a generated .hyperflow task file.
Resume execution from a selected batch or run only final integration review.
Build a multi-phase feature sequentially or one phase at a time.
Rehydrate and execute a second-session handoff package.
en.io: Input: task path or slug, optional handoff package, session/phase/resume/review-mode flags, and operational commit/branch/push arguments. Output: project changes, review verdicts, quality-gate results, commits or deferred queue state, progress metadata, memory artifacts, and audit/deploy prompts.
dependencies: Claude Code Agent, Skill, and AskUserQuestion capabilities
Hyperflow scripts and referenced prompt/policy files
Project lint, typecheck, and test tools when configured
Optional GitHub CLI for GitHub-native flows
en.boundary: Acts only on authored Hyperflow plans and project files. It does not deploy automatically without the documented end gate or handoff disposition. Security violations halt execution; unresolved worker or gate failures can leave partial task status and changes. Correct behavior depends on referenced Hyperflow files not included in this evidence.

zh.purpose: 通过并行工作代理、分层审查、质量门禁、提交、记忆更新和构建结束选择，执行 Hyperflow 任务或功能制品。
scenarios: 执行 .hyperflow 任务文件中的批次。
从指定批次恢复，或只运行最终集成审查。
连续构建多阶段功能，或一次只构建一个阶段。
还原并执行第二会话的交接包。
zh.io: 输入：任务路径或 slug、可选交接包、会话/阶段/恢复/审查模式参数，以及提交、分支、推送参数。输出：项目改动、审查结论、质量门禁结果、提交或延迟队列状态、进度元数据、记忆制品，以及审计/部署询问。
dependencies: Claude Code 的 Agent、Skill 和 AskUserQuestion 能力
Hyperflow 脚本及引用的提示词/策略文件
项目已配置的 lint、类型检查和测试工具
GitHub 原生流程可选依赖 GitHub CLI
zh.boundary: 仅依据已编写的 Hyperflow 计划操作项目文件。没有文档规定的结束门禁或交接处置时不会自动部署。安全违规会中止执行；未解决的代理或门禁失败可能留下部分状态和改动。完整行为依赖本证据未附带的 Hyperflow 引用文件。

grounding.scope: Hyperflow task-plan execution and multi-agent orchestration in a local project.

skills.name: design
skills.summary: Use when the user wants the visual/experiential design of a product done systematically — a design system, a screen, a landing page, or a visual identity — grounded in researched real-world prior art and free of AI slop. Establishes/extends the design system, invokes the matching local taste skill, dispatches the designer specialist, and reviews for taste + accessibility. Standalone — ends with a handoff gate into the chain. Trigger with /hyperflow:design, "design the UI", "make a design system", "design this screen", "give this a visual identity", "redesign this".

en.purpose: Creates or extends a project design system, researches multiple relevant products, authors a bound design specification, and gates it through taste and accessibility review.
scenarios: Design a screen or landing page.
Create a product visual identity.
Systematically redesign an existing interface.
en.io: Input: design brief, project context, existing design system, local taste skills, and at least two references. Output: .hyperflow/design/system.md, .hyperflow/specs/<slug>.md, taste and accessibility verdicts, and a build/plan/stop handoff choice.
dependencies: Claude Code agent and Skill dispatch
Relevant local taste skills when installed
Research access for current product references
en.boundary: Thinking and specification only; source-code changes are outside this phase. It depends on external specialist agents and reference access, and it does not establish that the design has been implemented or user-tested.

zh.purpose: 创建或扩展项目设计系统，研究多个相关产品，编写绑定设计规格，并通过品味与无障碍复核。
scenarios: 设计页面或落地页。
建立产品视觉身份。
系统性重设计现有界面。
zh.io: 输入：设计简报、项目背景、现有设计系统、本地 taste 技能及至少两个案例。输出：.hyperflow/design/system.md、.hyperflow/specs/<slug>.md、品味和无障碍结论，以及构建/规划/停止的交接选择。
dependencies: Claude Code 的代理与 Skill 调度
可写的 .hyperflow 设计与规格位置
已安装时的相关本地 taste 技能
获取当前产品案例的研究能力
zh.boundary: 只进行思考和规格编写，源码改动不在本阶段。依赖外部专家代理和参考资料访问，也不能证明设计已实现或经过用户测试。

skills.name: deploy
skills.summary: Use when ready to ship — runs pre-push gates (lint, typecheck, build, tests, security sweep), commits, releases, and pushes. Standalone, never auto-invoked. Push always requires explicit confirmation. Trigger with /hyperflow:deploy, "ship it", "ready to push", "release", "cut a release", "deploy".

security_findings.label: broad allowed-tools: Read, Write, Edit, Bash(git:*), Bash(npm:*), Bash(pnpm:*), B

en.purpose: Surveys repository state, runs quality and security gates, optionally creates a release, and pushes only according to an explicit or pre-elected push policy.
scenarios: Validate lint, formatting, types, builds, and tests before shipping.
Scan recent changes for secrets and audit dependencies.
Run a detected release workflow and verify version consistency.
Push a validated branch and tags after confirmation.
en.io: Input: repository state, Hyperflow context, project manifests/scripts, and push policy. Output: gate verdicts, optional fix/release commits and version changes, a push result, and a structured ship summary.
dependencies: Detected package manager and project gate commands
Hyperflow security and vulnerability reviewer agents
Optional release script, release-please, or Changesets
Network access for dependency-advisory research and push
en.boundary: Halts on failed quality gates, detected secrets, or applicable critical/high vulnerabilities. It does not bypass hooks or force-push. Missing commands may be skipped as described. User-owned uncommitted changes require an inclusion choice, and interactive confirmation is required when push policy is ask.

zh.purpose: 检查仓库状态，运行质量与安全门禁，可选执行发布，并仅按明确确认或预选策略推送。
scenarios: 发布前验证 lint、格式、类型、构建和测试。
扫描近期改动中的密钥并审计依赖。
运行检测到的发布流程并核对版本一致性。
确认后推送已验证的分支和标签。
zh.io: 输入：仓库状态、Hyperflow 上下文、项目清单/脚本和推送策略。输出：门禁结论、可选修复或发布提交、版本变化、推送结果和结构化发版摘要。
dependencies: 带远端的 Git 仓库
检测到的包管理器和项目门禁命令
Hyperflow 安全及漏洞审查代理
可选发布脚本、release-please 或 Changesets
依赖公告研究和推送所需网络
zh.boundary: 质量门禁失败、发现密钥或适用的严重/高危漏洞时停止。不会绕过钩子或强制推送。缺失命令可能按文档跳过。纳入用户已有未提交改动需要选择；push=ask 时需要交互确认。

grounding.scope: Pre-push validation, release preparation, and gated Git push for a local project.

skills.name: customer-success-manager
skills.summary: Monitors customer health, predicts churn risk, and identifies expansion opportunities using weighted scoring models for SaaS customer success. Use when analyzing customer accounts, reviewing retention metrics, scoring at-risk customers, or when the user mentions churn, customer health scores, upsell opportunities, expansion revenue, retention analysis, or customer analytics. Runs three Python CLI tools to produce deterministic health scores, churn risk tiers, and prioritized expansion recommendations across Enterprise, Mid-Market, and SMB segments.

en.purpose: Calculates weighted customer-health scores, churn-risk tiers, and ranked expansion opportunities from structured SaaS account data.
scenarios: Review a customer portfolio before a QBR.
Prioritize at-risk accounts for intervention.
Identify upsell, cross-sell, seat, or department expansion candidates.
en.io: Input: JSON customer records with segment, ARR, usage, engagement, support, relationship, commercial, contract, and product-adoption fields. Output: text or JSON health scores, risk tiers, trend signals, interventions, and estimated expansion opportunities.
dependencies: Manually exported CRM or customer-success data
Complete fields matching each script's schema
en.boundary: Point-in-time deterministic scoring only; there is no real-time integration or predictive ML. Default weights and thresholds may require calibration, and expansion revenue figures are approximations based on supplied usage patterns.

zh.purpose: 根据结构化 SaaS 客户数据计算加权客户状态分、流失风险层级和排序后的扩展机会。
scenarios: 在 QBR 前复盘客户组合。
确定高风险账户的干预优先级。
识别升配、交叉销售、席位或部门扩展候选。
zh.io: 输入：含分群、ARR、使用、互动、支持、关系、商业、合同和产品采用字段的客户 JSON。输出：文本或 JSON 的状态分、风险层级、趋势信号、干预建议和扩展机会估算。
dependencies: 手工导出的 CRM 或客户成功数据
符合各脚本 schema 的完整字段
zh.boundary: 只做时间点快照的确定性评分，没有实时集成或预测机器学习。默认权重和阈值可能需要校准，扩展收入仅为基于所给使用模式的估算。

skills.name: contract-and-proposal-writer
skills.summary: Generate professional, jurisdiction-aware business documents: freelance contracts, project proposals, SOWs, NDAs, and MSAs. Structured Markdown output with docx conversion instructions. Covers US (Delaware), EU (GDPR), UK, and DACH (German law) jurisdictions. Not a substitute for legal counsel — use as strong starting points. Use when drafting a freelance contract, preparing a client proposal, writing an SOW for a new engagement, or producing an NDA before sharing sensitive material.

en.purpose: Drafts structured Markdown starting points for freelance contracts, proposals, SOWs, NDAs, MSAs, SaaS partnerships, and GDPR processing clauses across listed jurisdictions.
scenarios: Draft a fixed-price development agreement.
Prepare a consulting retainer or SOW.
Create a mutual NDA or SaaS partnership draft.
en.io: Input: document type, jurisdiction, engagement model, parties, scope, price, dates, and special requirements. Output: filled Markdown draft with jurisdiction-oriented clauses, required-data markers, and optional DOCX conversion commands.
dependencies: Pandoc and a reference DOCX only when conversion is requested
Jurisdiction-specific facts for US-Delaware, EU, UK, or DACH selection
en.boundary: Templates are explicitly not a substitute for legal counsel. The evidence includes generalized jurisdiction notes that may be incomplete or outdated, so enforceability, tax, employment, privacy, and regulatory terms require local legal review.

zh.purpose: 为自由职业合同、提案、SOW、NDA、MSA、SaaS 合作和 GDPR 数据处理条款生成结构化 Markdown 初稿，覆盖列出的司法辖区。
scenarios: 起草固定价软件开发协议。
准备咨询顾问月费协议或 SOW。
创建双向 NDA 或 SaaS 合作草案。
zh.io: 输入：文件类型、司法辖区、合作模式、当事方、范围、价格、日期和特殊要求。输出：填充后的 Markdown 草案、属地化条款、缺失数据标记及可选 DOCX 转换命令。
dependencies: 用户提供的交易和主体信息
仅在需要转换时使用 Pandoc 与参考 DOCX
进行审查的合格法律顾问
选择美国特拉华、欧盟、英国或 DACH 所需的属地事实
zh.boundary: 模板明确不能替代法律顾问。来源中的属地说明是概括性的，可能不完整或过时；可执行性、税务、雇佣、隐私和监管条款需要当地律师审查。

skills.name: chief-data-officer-advisor
skills.summary: Chief Data Officer advisory for startups: AI training data rights and consent provenance, data product strategy (warehouse vs lakehouse vs mesh, build-vs-buy), B2B customer-data-as-asset valuation and M&A readiness, data team org evolution. Use when deciding whether to train models on customer data, choosing data architecture, valuing data for fundraising or M&A, sequencing data hires, or when user mentions CDO, chief data officer, data strategy, data mesh, lakehouse, training data, data product, data monetization, or customer data asset. NOT a tactical data engineering skill — strategic decisions only.

en.purpose: Supports strategic decisions about AI training-data rights, data architecture and build-vs-buy, customer-data asset value, and data-team sequencing.
scenarios: Assess whether a data source is eligible for model training.
Choose warehouse, lakehouse, or mesh direction.
Prepare data-asset valuation or an 18-month data hiring roadmap.
en.io: Input: data-source inventory, consent and data-class details, architecture profile, corpus characteristics, business consumers, and hiring needs. Output: use-case matrix, architecture recommendation, build-vs-buy split, risk-adjusted data value, productization paths, and role sequence.
dependencies: Python for ai_training_data_audit.py, data_product_strategy_picker.py, and data_asset_valuator.py
Accurate contractual, consent, corpus, and business-consumer data
Qualified privacy, IP, regulatory, and M&A counsel where applicable
Finance and engineering input for TCO and feasibility
en.boundary: Strategic rather than tactical data engineering. Legal and regulatory classifications require professional review, especially for training rights or external data products. Valuation and architecture thresholds are framework assumptions, not audited financial values or universal cutoffs.

zh.purpose: 支持 AI 训练数据权利、数据架构与自建/采购、客户数据资产价值和数据团队招聘顺序等战略决策。
scenarios: 评估某数据源能否用于模型训练。
选择数据仓库、湖仓或数据网格方向。
准备数据资产估值或 18 个月团队路线图。
zh.io: 输入：数据源清单、同意与数据类别、架构画像、语料特征、业务使用方和招聘需求。输出：用例矩阵、架构建议、自建/采购拆分、风险调整后的数据价值、产品化路径和岗位顺序。
dependencies: 准确的合同、同意、语料和业务消费信息
适用时的隐私、IP、监管和并购律师
用于 TCO 与可行性的财务和工程输入
zh.boundary: 属于战略咨询，不做战术数据工程。训练权利和外部数据产品的法律监管分类需专业审查；估值与架构阈值是框架假设，不是审计财务价值或普适标准。

skills.name: chief-customer-officer-advisor
skills.summary: Chief Customer Officer advisory for startups: retention decomposition (gross retention vs NRR honesty, churn root-cause taxonomy), customer segmentation strategy (differential investment across tiers + ICP fit scoring), CS team coverage model (pooled vs named CSM thresholds + ratio math), and CS team org evolution (CS vs Support vs AM distinctions). Use when designing retention strategy, segmenting customers for differential investment, sizing CS team, or sequencing CS hires. Strategic only — does not duplicate engineering/business-growth tactical skills.

en.purpose: Decomposes retention, designs differentiated customer segments, calculates CS coverage models, and sequences customer-team roles.
scenarios: Review gross retention separately from NRR.
Re-segment customers by ARR and ICP fit.
Size pooled, named, or tech-touch CSM coverage.
en.io: Input: cohort retention data, customer ARR and ICP signals, account book composition, service complexity, and current staffing. Output: GRR/NRR decomposition, churn taxonomy, segment assignments, investment tiers, required CSM headcount, transition thresholds, and hiring sequence.
dependencies: Python for retention_decomposition_analyzer.py, customer_segmentation_designer.py, and cs_coverage_calculator.py
Accurate cohort, ARR, churn, customer, and staffing data
Finance, product, revenue, and HR input for cross-functional decisions
en.boundary: Strategic only; it does not implement CRM workflows, health scoring, or onboarding automation. Benchmarks are B2B SaaS baselines and may not fit consumer, marketplace, or hardware businesses.

zh.purpose: 拆解留存、设计差异化客户分层、计算客户成功覆盖模型，并规划客户团队岗位顺序。
scenarios: 把毛留存与 NRR 分开复盘。
按 ARR 和 ICP 匹配度重新分层客户。
测算 pooled、named 或 tech-touch CSM 覆盖。
zh.io: 输入：留存队列数据、客户 ARR 与 ICP 信号、账户组合、服务复杂度和现有人员。输出：GRR/NRR 拆解、流失分类、客户分层、投入档位、所需 CSM 人数、转换阈值和招聘顺序。
dependencies: 准确的队列、ARR、流失、客户和人员数据
跨职能决策所需的财务、产品、营收和 HR 输入
zh.boundary: 只做战略层分析，不实施 CRM 流程、状态评分或入职自动化。基准面向 B2B SaaS，未必适用于消费者、平台型或硬件业务。

skills.name: chief-ai-officer-advisor
skills.summary: Chief AI Officer advisory for startups: model build-vs-buy decisions (API vs fine-tune vs in-house), AI risk classification under EU AI Act + US state patchwork, AI cost economics (API-to-self-hosted breakeven), and AI team org evolution. Use when deciding whether to call an API or fine-tune, classifying AI use cases for regulatory risk, calculating when self-hosting pays off, sequencing AI hires, or when user mentions CAIO, AI strategy, model selection, foundation model, fine-tuning, EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, AI governance, model risk, or AI economics. Strategic only — does not duplicate engineering AI/ML skills.

en.purpose: Supports strategic choices among model APIs, fine-tuning, and in-house models; classifies AI use-case risk; models inference economics; and sequences AI hiring.
scenarios: Compare API and fine-tuning for a product use case.
Identify governance controls for a regulated AI use case.
Estimate API-to-self-hosted breakeven and plan AI roles.
en.io: Input: workload volume, latency, quality targets, team, budget, use-case sector/geography, affected decisions, and GPU/API assumptions. Output: three-year TCO comparison, risk tier and control list, breakeven sensitivity, and AI-team roadmap.
dependencies: Python for model_buildvsbuy_calculator.py, ai_risk_classifier.py, and ai_cost_economics.py
Current model pricing and GPU-cost inputs
Qualified AI regulatory counsel for binding classifications
en.boundary: Strategic only; it does not implement RAG, agents, evaluations, or deployment. Pricing and regulatory statements are time-sensitive assumptions, and automated classifications cannot replace jurisdiction-specific legal analysis or empirical model evaluation.

zh.purpose: 支持模型 API、微调与自建之间的战略选择，分类 AI 用例风险，建模推理经济性，并规划 AI 招聘。
scenarios: 比较产品用例采用 API 或微调。
识别受监管 AI 用例所需治理控制。
估算 API 转自托管的盈亏平衡并规划岗位。
zh.io: 输入：工作量、延迟、质量目标、团队、预算、用例行业/地域、受影响决策及 GPU/API 假设。输出：三年 TCO 对比、风险层级与控制清单、盈亏平衡敏感性和 AI 团队路线。
dependencies: 当前模型价格和 GPU 成本输入
作出约束性分类所需的 AI 监管律师
zh.boundary: 只做战略分析，不实施 RAG、代理、评测或部署。价格和监管陈述具有时效性；自动分类不能替代属地法律分析或真实模型评测。

skills.name: challenge
skills.summary: Pre-mortem plan analysis. Imagine the plan failed 12 months from now and work backwards to find the weaknesses. Surfaces assumptions, dependencies, and execution risks before committing resources. Use when before significant resource commitment, before presenting to a board or investors, when feedback has been one-sidedly positive, or when there is pressure to move fast and figure it out later.

en.purpose: Imagines a plan has failed, extracts its assumptions, rates confidence and impact, maps dependency chains, assesses reversibility, and defines kill switches and hardening actions.
scenarios: Challenge a product roadmap before committing resources.
Stress-test a fundraising or hiring plan.
Prepare vulnerabilities before a board presentation.
en.io: Input: plan, evidence behind assumptions, dependencies, commitments, and time horizon. Output: assumption register, vulnerability map, dependency chain, reversible and irreversible bets, 30/60/90-day kill switches, and hardening actions.
dependencies: Evidence or explicit uncertainty for major assumptions
Stakeholder input for dependencies and commitments
en.boundary: A pre-mortem framework, not a prediction. Confidence and impact labels depend on supplied evidence and judgment. It identifies risks but does not decide whether the organization should proceed.

zh.purpose: 假设计划已经失败，再反向提取假设、评估置信与影响、绘制依赖链、判断可逆性，并定义停止条件和加固动作。
scenarios: 在投入资源前挑战产品路线图。
压力测试融资或招聘计划。
在董事会汇报前准备漏洞清单。
zh.io: 输入：计划、假设证据、依赖、承诺和时间范围。输出：假设登记表、漏洞地图、依赖链、可逆/不可逆下注、30/60/90 天停止条件和加固动作。
dependencies: 主要假设的证据或明确不确定性
用于确认依赖和承诺的利益相关者输入
zh.boundary: 这是事前验尸框架，不是预测。置信和影响标签取决于所给证据与判断；它识别风险，但不替组织作出是否继续的决定。

skills.name: capacity-planner
skills.summary: Use when an ops leader (Director of CX, Head of Support, VP Ops, Head of BizOps, Head of IT ops, Head of Finance ops) is sizing ops capacity, building a headcount plan, modeling utilization risk, planning Q3 capacity or annual support capacity, or designing CS coverage — and needs Erlang-C queueing math, P90 demand sizing, shrinkage-adjusted FTE, manager-trigger thresholds, and a quarterly hiring sequence with ramp + attrition. Apply when sustained team utilization is above 80% or when the team is growing >50% in 12 months. Run before committing the headcount budget. This is NOT engineering capacity (see vpe-advisor for DORA + cycle time) and NOT strategic 3-year workforce planning (see chro-advisor).

en.purpose: Uses queueing and workforce arithmetic to size operations teams, analyze utilization imbalance, and sequence quarterly hiring with shrinkage, ramp, attrition, and management spans.
scenarios: Build an annual support headcount plan.
Model P90 demand and SLA-breach probability.
Plan quarterly hiring for a growing CX or operations team.
en.io: Input: P50/P90/P99 demand, average handling time, SLA target, FTE, shrinkage, utilization, ramp, attrition, growth, and profile. Output: capacity tables, breach probabilities, utilization findings, risk bands, and 12-month hiring sequence.
dependencies: At least 90 days of demand data for the stated baseline
en.boundary: For queued operations, not engineering project work or long-range strategic workforce planning. Assumes sufficiently stable demand and single-class queues; priority tiers should be modeled separately. Results are sensitive to demand distribution and AHT inputs.

zh.purpose: 使用排队与人力算术测算运营团队容量、分析利用率不均，并在考虑损耗、爬坡、流失和管理跨度后安排季度招聘。
scenarios: 制定年度客服编制计划。
建模 P90 需求和 SLA 违约概率。
为增长中的 CX 或运营团队规划季度招聘。
zh.io: 输入：P50/P90/P99 需求、平均处理时长、SLA、FTE、损耗、利用率、爬坡、流失、增长和画像。输出：容量表、违约概率、利用率发现、风险档位和 12 个月招聘顺序。
dependencies: 用于所述基线的至少 90 天需求数据
已测量的瓶颈和服务假设
zh.boundary: 适用于排队型运营，不适合工程项目或长期战略人力规划。假设需求相对稳定且队列单一类别；优先级队列应分开建模。结果对需求分布和 AHT 输入高度敏感。

skills.name: cache
skills.summary: Use when the user wants to view, search, add, edit, prune, archive, or clear hyperflow memory entries. CRUD interface for `.hyperflow/memory/` — never modifies source code, only memory files. Trigger with /hyperflow:cache, "show memory", "search memory for X", "clear memory", "what does hyperflow remember about Y".

security_findings.label: broad allowed-tools: Read, Write, Edit, Bash(ls:*), Bash(mv:*), Bash(rm:*), Glob,

en.purpose: Provides lifecycle operations for viewing, searching, adding, editing, pruning, archiving, clearing, migrating, and compacting Hyperflow memory entries.
scenarios: Search or inspect remembered project decisions and patterns.
Add or edit categorized memory entries.
Archive, prune, clear, or compact aged memory.
Import project-matching entries from a legacy global memory file.
en.io: Input: a cache subcommand plus query, category, entry ID, or target file as applicable. Output: matching entries, statistics, mutation confirmation, archive paths, or compaction counts.
en.boundary: Targets memory files rather than source code. Clear requires confirmation and archives content instead of irreversibly discarding it. Migration reads only the described legacy file and filters by project. Detailed parsing and compaction behavior depends on referenced files not attached here.

zh.purpose: 为 Hyperflow 项目记忆提供查看、搜索、新增、编辑、修剪、归档、清空、迁移和压缩等生命周期操作。
scenarios: 搜索或查看已记录的项目决策与模式。
新增或编辑分类记忆条目。
归档、修剪、清空或压缩旧记忆。
从旧版全局记忆文件导入与当前项目匹配的条目。
zh.io: 输入：cache 子命令及相应查询、类别、条目 ID 或目标文件。输出：匹配条目、统计、变更确认、归档路径或压缩计数。
dependencies: Hyperflow 记忆协议引用文件
压缩写入和审查所需 Agent 能力
可选 memory-index.py 刷新脚本
zh.boundary: 只面向记忆文件，不修改源代码。清空需要确认，并通过归档保留内容。迁移只读取所述旧文件并按项目过滤。具体解析和压缩行为依赖本证据未附带的引用文件。

skills.name: business-operations-skills
skills.summary: Use when running, diagnosing, or designing internal business operations — process documentation, vendor SLAs, capacity planning, internal comms, SOP/runbook authoring, procurement spend. Triggers on "BizOps review", "where's the bottleneck", "vendor health", "internal SOP", "all-hands deck", "spend categorization", "capacity for Q3", "process mapping". Forks context to route to one of six BizOps sub-skills (process-mapper, vendor-management, capacity-planner, internal-comms, knowledge-ops, procurement-optimizer) and returns a digest. Distinct from business-growth (external sales motion) and c-level-advisor (strategic, not operational).

en.purpose: Classifies internal-operations requests and routes them to one of six specialist skills for process, vendor, capacity, communications, knowledge, or procurement work.
scenarios: Choose the correct skill for a BizOps review.
Route a mixed vendor-SLA and spend question in stages.
Keep heavy operational intake in a forked context.
en.io: Input: an internal-operations request and optional local artifacts. Output: selected sub-skill invocation, at most one clarifying question when ambiguous, and a short digest with findings, actions, artifact paths, and one challenge.
dependencies: Six sibling skills: process-mapper, vendor-management, capacity-planner, internal-comms, knowledge-ops, procurement-optimizer
Reference materials used by the selected skill
en.boundary: Routes to exactly one primary lane at a time and does not itself perform specialist analysis. Mixed lanes require explicit follow-up before a second route. The manifest evidence does not include the referenced vendor-management skill content.

zh.purpose: 分类内部运营请求，并路由到流程、供应商、容量、内部沟通、知识或采购六类专家技能之一。
scenarios: 为 BizOps 复盘选择正确技能。
分阶段处理供应商 SLA 与支出混合问题。
把重型运营资料保留在分叉上下文。
zh.io: 输入：内部运营请求和可选本地产物。输出：选定的子技能调用；模糊时至多一个澄清问题；以及包含发现、动作、产物路径和一个挑战的短摘要。
dependencies: 可用时的本地产物读取能力
所选技能使用的参考资料
zh.boundary: 一次只路由一个主要领域，本身不进行专家分析。混合领域在进入第二路线前需明确跟进。本清单证据未包含被引用的 vendor-management 技能正文。

skills.name: business-growth-skills
skills.summary: Router/index for the 4 business & growth skills bundled in this plugin: customer-success-manager (health scoring, churn risk, expansion), sales-engineer (RFP analysis, competitive matrices, PoC planning), revenue-operations (pipeline, forecast accuracy, GTM efficiency), and contract-and-proposal-writer. Use when a growth/revenue request doesn't obviously match one skill and you need to pick the right one (e.g., 'which accounts are at risk', 'should we bid on this RFP').

en.purpose: Routes ambiguous revenue and growth requests to customer success, sales engineering, revenue operations, or contract/proposal drafting.
scenarios: Choose a skill for account-risk analysis.
Route an RFP or proof-of-concept request.
Select between pipeline analytics and commercial document drafting.
en.io: Input: growth or revenue request. Output: exactly one selected skill path, or one clarifying question when multiple categories match.
en.boundary: A router only; it ships no analysis tools. The selected specialist's inputs and limitations apply. The supplied evidence does not include the sales-engineer skill content, so its detailed behavior is not assessed here.

zh.purpose: 把模糊的营收与增长请求路由到客户成功、销售工程、营收运营或合同/提案起草。
scenarios: 为账户风险分析选择技能。
路由 RFP 或概念验证请求。
在管道分析和商业文件起草之间选择。
zh.io: 输入：增长或营收请求。输出：唯一的技能路径；若多个类别同时匹配，则提出一个澄清问题。

skills.name: bridge

zh.purpose: 生成、刷新、移除或检查受管理的 Hyperflow doctrine 区块，使非 CLI 的 Claude 界面可加载部分 Hyperflow 行为规则。
scenarios: 把可移植 Hyperflow 规则加入 CLAUDE.md。

只移除受管理的 doctrine 区块。
将自动维护模式设为自动、手动或关闭。

dependencies: 当前或随附的 Hyperflow 插件安装
自动维护所需的会话启动钩子
zh.boundary: 只迁移文档所述的行为子集，不提供斜杠命令、技能调度、后台代理或完整自适应流程。遇到损坏或重复的标记区块会拒绝修改，以免覆盖含义不明的用户内容。auto 模式可在会话启动时修改 CLAUDE.md。

skills.name: board-prep

Rehearse an investor update after a revenue miss.
Build a pre-read and explicit asks for a high-stakes review.

为高风险审查准备预读材料和明确诉求。

董事重点及既往承诺信息

skills.name: background

security_findings.label: broad allowed-tools: Read, Write, Edit, Bash(ls:*), Bash(cat:*), Bash(rm:*), Bash

Read a completed agent's output buffer.

Prune terminal-state buffers older than seven days.

zh.purpose: 列出、查看、标记取消或修剪由其他 Hyperflow 流程先前启动的后台代理。

Hyperflow reviewer agents and prompt/reference files
Web research for current security advisories in gated specialist reviews

Hyperflow 审查代理及提示词/引用文件

门禁式安全审查所需的当前漏洞公告研究

Referenced OKF conformance and type-vocabulary documents

每个阶段的创始人确认
被引用的 OKF 一致性和类型词汇文档

skills.name: agent-protocol

Run independent board-meeting analyses before synthesis.

可用的 C-suite 顾问角色
可选的 company-context.md 和已批准决策记录
用于持久化决策的记录组件

skills.name: agent-launcher-orchestrator
skills.summary: Use when a user wants to build, launch, grade, or schedule a Claude Managed Agent (CMA) in their own Anthropic account — "build me an agent", "launch this as a managed agent", "run this on a schedule", "grade my agent against a rubric", "set up a nightly worker". Reads the per-session goal (./my-agent/goal.json), routes deterministically to one of five phase sub-skills (interview → stage-launch → grade-iterate → run-without-you → wrap-up) via goal_router.py, and compiles the goal+phase into an execution shape (single-pass workflow / bounded grade→iterate loop / recurring cron deployment loop) via loop_compiler.py. Forks context so heavy intake (build sheets, payloads, eval cases) stays out of the parent thread. All launches are emitted as BYOK curl the user runs with their own key; no tool makes API calls. Inspired by anthropics/launch-your-agent (Apache-2.0). Distinct from engineering/agent-harness (generic domain loop) and engineering/write-a-skill (authors Claude Code skills, not CMAs).

en.purpose: Reads a per-agent goal, routes deterministically through interview, launch, evaluation, scheduling, and wrap-up phases, and compiles the appropriate single-pass, bounded-loop, or cron-loop shape.
scenarios: Start building a managed agent.
Resume the correct lifecycle phase from goal.json.
Compile a graded agent into a scheduled deployment plan.
en.io: Input: ./my-agent/goal.json, agent name, output directory, recurrence, max iterations, and optional cron/timezone. Output: selected phase, plan.v1 loop shape, phase artifacts, updated goal state, BYOK curl material, and a short parent-thread digest.
dependencies: User-provided Anthropic API key used only in user-run curl
en.boundary: The tools never make API calls or print credentials. A missing or vague goal blocks routing. It orchestrates artifacts and phases but does not independently implement the external Claude Managed Agent service.

zh.purpose: 读取单个代理目标，确定性地路由访谈、启动、评测、调度和收尾阶段，并编译单次、有界循环或 cron 循环执行形态。
scenarios: 开始构建托管代理。
根据 goal.json 恢复正确生命周期阶段。
把已评分代理编译成定时部署计划。
zh.io: 输入：./my-agent/goal.json、代理名称、输出目录、重复方式、最大迭代及可选 cron/时区。输出：所选阶段、plan.v1 循环形态、阶段产物、更新后的目标状态、BYOK curl 材料和短摘要。
dependencies: 仅用于用户自己运行 curl 的 Anthropic API 密钥
zh.boundary: 工具不调用 API，也不打印凭据。目标缺失或过于模糊时会阻塞；它编排产物和阶段，但不实现外部 Claude Managed Agent 服务。

管理子任务、依赖、周期、模板和模型选择。
将已批准的 To-Do 任务并行分发给代理。

uv and bundled Python entry points

Review dashboard and human decisions for unresolved items
Optional permitted second recognizer and source audio
GLM API key only for the separate agent-less API route

Netblock/ASN attribution via org-first RIR queries (ARIN Whois-RWS org-handle search, RIPE DB organisation + inverse-org search) that recover 'dark netblocks' with no DNS link to the seed, ASN discovery (RIPEstat + BGPView union), the HYPERSCALER-SCOPE GUARD (never attribute a whole AWS/GCP/Azure/Cloudflare announced range to a tenant — keep only the seed-containing block, tag shared_hosting_cdn), and org-identity-seeded internet-scan-index queries (Shodan/Censys/ZoomEye/FOFA/BinaryEdge org: filters + an always-on keyless crt.sh fallback). Concrete wordlists (28 Swagger paths, 13 GraphQL paths, 35 high-risk ports, 6 missing-header findings, 15 always-on HTTP checks, 5 SAML paths, cloud bucket permutations, JS guess-paths, vendor product fingerprints for Citrix/F5/Pulse/Fortinet/Cisco/PaloAlto/VMware/Exchange, cloud-native service fingerprints, container/K8s exposure paths, CI/CD platform paths, documentation/wiki leak paths, WHOIS/RDAP, DNS record catalog, Wayback CDX recipes), 80-pattern secret-regex catalog (incl. modern AI API keys: Anthropic/OpenAI/HuggingFace/Cloudflare/DigitalOcean/npm/PyPI/Docker Hub/Atlassian/DataDog/Sentry/ngrok; skills.name: meeting-minutes-taker
skills.summary: Transforms raw meeting transcripts into high-fidelity, structured meeting minutes (notes / summaries). Use when (1) a meeting transcript is provided and meeting minutes, notes, or a summary are requested; (2) multiple versions of minutes must be merged without losing content; (3) existing minutes need review against the original transcript for missing items; (4) the transcript has anonymous speakers like "Speaker 1/2/3" or "发言人1" that need identifying (optionally mapped via a context.md team directory). Triggers on 会议纪要 / 会议记录 / 整理纪要 / 妙记转纪要, "write meeting minutes", "summarize this meeting", "merge these minutes", "what's missing from these notes". For fixing ASR/STT recognition errors in the raw transcript first, use transcript-fixer; this skill structures clean transcripts into minutes.

en.purpose: Transforms meeting transcripts into structured, evidence-backed minutes through redundant complete passes, union merging, completeness review, and human validation.
scenarios: Create minutes with decisions, action items, discussion, open questions, and supporting quotes.
Merge several minutes drafts without losing unique content.
Audit existing notes against a transcript or identify anonymous speakers with user-confirmed mappings.
en.io: Inputs are transcripts, optional project/team context, reference artifacts, and external draft minutes. Outputs are Markdown minutes, intermediate complete-pass drafts, diagrams, retrieval-test claims, and review statistics.
dependencies: Readable transcript and optional context files
Multiple isolated agent passes for the specified full workflow
Optional transcript-fixer and document conversion tools
en.boundary: Structures transcript evidence rather than correcting ASR. Speaker identity must not be silently inferred; source-side labeling or user confirmation is preferred. Drafts require human review, and claims from external drafts must be verified against the transcript.

skills.name: local-conversation-history
skills.summary: Entry point for local AI conversation history across providers. Routes a request to the one skill that owns it, by platform (Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Kimi CLI) and action (read evidence vs continue interrupted work), and owns the one job none of them own alone: a single inventory spanning all three providers. Use when the provider is unknown or plural ("our history", "what have I been working on", "which chats did I have"), when the user wants Kimi CLI history at all, when it is unclear whether they need evidence or resumption, or when they ask for this skill by name. Vague recall that names no platform ("we discussed this once, when was it?") belongs here rather than to a single-provider reader, because a Claude-only answer to an unscoped question cannot support an absence claim. When the platform and the action are both already clear, load that executor skill directly instead — except Kimi CLI, which has no reader or continuation skill of its own and always routes through here.

en.purpose: Route local AI conversation-history requests to the correct provider-specific reader or continuation workflow for Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, or Kimi CLI, and define cross-provider inventory/search scope.
scenarios: Route a known Claude Code or Codex read request to its dedicated history reader.
Identify the provider for an unknown session ID before any continuation.
List recent sessions across Claude Code, Codex, and Kimi CLI.
Search conversation content across multiple providers.
Route continuation only after verified session evidence exists.
en.io: Inputs are provider hints, session IDs, keywords, workspace paths, and whether the user wants evidence or continuation. Outputs are a selected executor skill and explicit provider scope; for cross-provider tasks, the delegated executor returns inventories or search results.
dependencies: Provider-specific Claude Code and Codex history skills
Local history stores for each requested provider
en.boundary: The router does not parse history or implement provider-specific commands. It must not guess a provider from ID shape, route a past-evidence question to continuation, or claim absence from partial coverage. Kimi has no continuation workflow in the documented routing table.

skills.name: identity-provider-recon

Covers domain-to-tenant resolution (Microsoft getuserrealm.srf Managed/Federated namespace check, Entra OIDC metadata tenant-GUID extraction, Autodiscover v2), keyless Microsoft tenant-federation mapping (GetFederationInformation SOAP -> sibling-domain discovery, discover-only ROE, FEDERATED_WITH provenance edge held out of attack-path pivoting), Okta org-slug derivation + OIDC fingerprint + governed custom-domain enumeration, ADFS passive/active fingerprint + version inference, Google Workspace MX-correlated detection, generic OIDC (Auth0/Keycloak/Ping Identity/OneLogin/Duo) discovery, SAML metadata (5 paths), Azure AD Seamless-SSO Negotiate-challenge detection, Microsoft Defender for Identity (MDI) sensor-API presence check, the user-enumeration oracle methodology for Microsoft GetCredentialType (IfExistsResult semantics: exists / doesn't-exist / exists-in-federated-tenant / throttled) and Okta /api/v1/authn (errorCode differential), Medium-detectability discipline with a hard 20-candidate-per-tenant cap and admin/role interest-based ranking, and name x confirmed-email-pattern login-candidate synthesis that FAILS CLOSED with zero output when no org pattern is confirmed. Grounded directly in a production ASM implementation's sso_idp.py, tenant_recon.py, and core/email_patterns.py modules. Deepens — does not duplicate — offensive-osint skill's Identity Fabric endpoint reference with the tenant-federation MAP, the oracle WORKFLOW, and the candidate-SYNTHESIS methodology that reference lacks. Use when fingerprinting an organization's identity provider, mapping its tenant/federation boundary, running an authorized pre-auth user-enumeration pass, or synthesizing login candidates from harvested names to feed that oracle — never for password spray, credential submission, or auth bypass.

en.purpose: Provides organization-grade identity-fabric mapping and pre-authentication user enumeration methodology without performing credential submission.
scenarios: Mapping tenant and federation boundaries during authorized attack surface management.
Fingerprinting Identity Providers (IdP) such as Entra ID, Okta, ADFS, and Google Workspace.
Generating and validating login candidate patterns for pre-auth user enumeration.

skills.name: email-domain-security
skills.summary: Rigorous, defensible email-spoofability verdict and SPF supply-chain risk analysis computed from published DNS alone. Deepens the record-level SPF/DMARC/DKIM/BIMI/MTA-STS/DNSSEC fetch recipes in the offensive-osint arsenal (§16.14) with the reasoning that section doesn't do: a priority-ordered composite verdict for whether an attacker can actually land header-From-spoofed mail in an inbox, and by which vector (exact-domain vs subdomain) — grounded in the single most-misunderstood distinction in email security: the envelope MAIL FROM that SPF authenticates vs the visible header From: that only DMARC governs. Explains precisely why SPF -all/~all alone is NOT spoof-proof without DMARC enforcement, and why SPF +all bypasses DMARC even under p=reject pct=100. Covers RFC 7208 §4.6.4's 10-DNS-lookup / 2-void-lookup PermError fail-open condition with a runnable stdlib-only lookup-counter script, plus the SPF-include-takeover supply-chain vector (an attacker re-registering a dead include inherits SPF-pass authority over the victim domain) with strict transient-vs-NXDOMAIN discrimination discipline so a temporary SERVFAIL is never mistaken for a takeover lead. Fully passive: DNS TXT reads only, no mail sent, no RCPT TO probe, no API keys. Use when auditing a domain's real spoofing resistance (not just its published records), explaining to a client why 'we have SPF -all' does not mean they're covered, investigating an SPF PermError or an unusually long include chain, evaluating a dead SPF include as a takeover lead, or writing a defensible spoofability finding for a deliverable.

en.purpose: Evaluates email spoofing feasibility and SPF supply-chain risks based purely on published DNS records.
scenarios: Auditing email spoofing feasibility and DMARC/SPF enforcement posture for a target domain.
Investigating SPF PermError lookup limits and analyzing long include chains.
Identifying SPF include takeover vulnerabilities caused by dangling include domains.
